text:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #4921 is failing CI on a seemingly flaky test in the embeddings shard. Mac renderer snapshot diff attached. Can someone take a quick look? https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/4921
ci-bot: CI failed on job `macos-integ-shard3` (run 204). Failing test: `tests/embeddings/test_index.py::TestShard3::test_kv_collision`
```
AssertionError: snapshots differ
- expected: <image 12345>
+ actual:   <image 12346>
Trace: .../render/renderer.cpp:412
```
sam: Is this only on macos? I see linux and windows passed. Could be nondet rendering or snapshot seed noise. Can we do a targeted rerun first?
maria: I can take it. Do I have perms to trigger a targeted rerun for shard3? If yes I'll kick it off and try a local repro. @alex do you want me to also try the snapshot locally?
alex: Yes please do a targeted rerun (shard3) first. If it passes twice we'll merge. If it fails again, hold and assign for deeper triage.
ci-bot: Targeted rerun queued: `rerun --job macos-integ-shard3 --pr 4921` (position 2). ETA ~3m.
maria: Local repro command that helped me last time:
```
# run just that test locally
pytest tests/embeddings/test_index.py::TestShard3::test_kv_collision -q -k 'kv_collision' -k 'renderer' -s
# or run the mac render helper
./tools/render_test --shard 3 --seed 42
```
irene: I looked at related failures last week — sometimes the renderer introduces tiny anti-alias diffs when GPU driver changes. If the change in this PR touched fonts or padding we might need a snapshot update instead of a fix. Can someone paste the diff image or a tiny crop? :eyes:
sam: Pasted a 200px crop to the PR comments: small shift on the right edge. If that shift is intentional (PR touches layout) update snapshot. If not, rerun until we can reproduce locally. My rule: two green reruns -> merge.
alex: Plan: maria will wait for the targeted rerun. If CI passes two consecutive runs, I'll merge and tag with `merge/approved` (need 1 LGTM from @sam or @irene). If it flakes again, assign to @irene for GPU/renderer triage and open a small bisect issue. Maria — ping here when rerun finishes.
maria: Starting rerun now, standing by. :thumbsup:
